name: HYUNDAI MOVEX Co., Ltd.
summary: HYUNDAI MOVEX Co., Ltd. operates in the information technology (IT) and logistics system businesses in South Korea and internationally. It offers engineering solutions based on system construction; logistics services to the distribution/parcel, freezing/cooling, tire, petrochemical, airport, pharmaceutical, automobile, manufacturing, hospital, food and beverage, clothing, and process logistics sectors; consulting services for design support, factory automation, and material handling automation; and platform screen doors.
